authority_note: This is a MAP, not a registry. It confers no trust, establishes no owner acceptance, and MUST NOT be consumed as a RAPP/1 §13 authenticated registry. A §13 entry requires estate-owner acceptance and signing authority. The protocol authority is kody-w/rapp-1; the governance authority is kody-w/RAPP/CONSTITUTION.md. Where this map and either authority disagree, the authority wins and this map is the defect.

supersedes.why: Its ecosystem-spec.json is disposition 'quarantined-candidate' with accepted_as_rapp1_registry false — it drifted toward claiming registry authority it never had. It also drifted in vocabulary: 544 uses of 'hatch' against 277 of 'plant', while the membrane (Lexicon word 5) appeared 5 times and DOG 4. A map whose words disagree with the Lexicon cannot route anyone correctly.

rules: An organism is a planted being (word 3). The verb is PLANT.
HATCH belongs to eggs (Article L), never to organisms.
The membrane splits every organism exactly once (word 5): BONES public, VAULT private.
The DOG is the bones walking. The GOD is bones + vault — the whole that CONTAINS the DOG.
A twin is not an organism (Article XLIX); it is a persistent AI presence.
A rappid is identity (word 4). A name is never identity — only a hash is.
The brainstem is blood, bones and connective tissue — the living substrate. It is bones; its .brainstem_data/ is vault. No change needed: the grail is the grail.

membrane.bones: Public surfaces. Their exhaust is the DOG — safe to publish by construction.
membrane.vault: Private flesh. Local-first, never on a remote. Bones + vault is the GOD.
membrane.law: Public flows down; private never flows on its own (Art. XLVIII, Art. LVI).
membrane.brainstem: The brainstem is the living substrate — blood, bones and connective tissue. It is bones-side: the engine, the loader, the wire. Its .brainstem_data/ is vault-side. So a brainstem is already a whole organism across the membrane, and needs no change to fit this pattern. The grail is the grail.

surfaces.note: Its API is same-origin by design (API='' on http/https; only file:// falls back to 127.0.0.1:7071), so it talks to whichever brainstem SERVED the page — parent on 7071, booted twin on 7081+. Served from Pages there is no brainstem (POST /chat -> 405) and it degrades to its browser-only path. A twin is local-first, so in that mode there is correctly NO twin: system_context injects nothing and the agent says how to plant one.

surfaces.houses: Public bones served from Pages that locate the GOD layer without ever carrying it. Probes loopback for a burrowed brainstem and hands the user through to it.
surfaces.note: The membrane made operable. Detection is an opaque no-cors GET: a 403 is an answer, silence is not — so it never reads a byte, never asks for X-Brainstem-Secret, and never proxies. On a sighting it opens http://localhost:<port>/ where the brainstem serves the same bones same-origin with every guard intact. A signpost, not a bridge. Verified end-to-end in Chrome 131 from the live https page against a real brainstem on 7071.
